proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 58 prints /pittə/ “bile.” Turner8181 gives Old Indo-Aryan pittá, Pali and Prakrit pitta, Oriya pita and Assamese pit “bile”; the Darai dental geminate and meaning match. Turner notes possible ultimate Munda origin, but this Indo-Aryan word is the relevant ancestor.
